subtitle: Out Cebu · Cebu Pacific
overview: Fly Cebu Pacific from Cebu to Shanghai and stay three nights in a 4★ hotel with daily breakfast. Day 2 covers the Bund, Oriental Pearl Tower (outside view), Nanjing Road and Chenghuang Temple, Day 3 is a free day (optional Shanghai Disneyland), and the last day brings Wukang Road, Florentia Town and a few shopping stops before the early-morning flight home.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Dec 12–16 2026 to Mar 27–31 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverside promenade lined with historic buildings, with views across the Huangpu River.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: A landmark TV tower in Pudong with spheres on its frame; the tour views it from outside.
placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's main shopping street and pedestrian walkway, open for free shopping time.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple: A Taoist temple area in the old city, known for its traditional shops and snack stalls.
placeDesc.World’s largest Starbucks Flagship Store: A large Starbucks Reserve Roastery in Shanghai, visited as a sightseeing stop.
placeDesc.LV Mega Ship: A ship-shaped Louis Vuitton exhibition and store building on the Shanghai waterfront.
placeDesc.Wukang Road: A tree-lined street in the former French Concession with historic villas, cafes and shops.
placeDesc.Shanghai Florentia Town: An outlet shopping village in Shanghai with European-style streets and brand stores.
placeDesc.Shanghai Disneyland (optional): Optional day on the free day: the Disney theme park in Pudong, booked separately for an extra fee.
placeDesc.Huangpu River (optional cruise): Optional evening cruise along the Huangpu River past the Bund and Pudong skyline.
